feedback: No race has been run for this geometry or for any earlier design, so there is no outcome evidence yet. The integration work so far is only what the contract required. The sensor weights are set to the signed lateral positions (-2 to +2) so the signal is sign-correct, and I used a conservative kp of 2 with ki 0 to avoid overshoot on a first race. Next race, the change depends on what it shows. If line_loss_events are nonzero and they cluster at bend entries, the sensors are seeing the line too late. Widen the array to x = ±0.03 or move the sensors further ahead (y = 0.06) so the line is seen earlier. If the sharpest bends saturate or drop out (the outer sensors read 1 and the signal stops changing), use sensor_size 0.016 so the footprint covers more of the 25 mm tape, or reduce the sensor spread. If the rms_error is high on gentle bends with no line loss, the array is too narrow for a stable signal, so widen it. If the robot is stable but misses the 3 s finish, reduce the mass or the yaw inertia (body_length or body_width) so the robot can carry speed through turns.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events cluster at bend entries in the next race: move sensor_positions y from 0.04 to 0.06 so the array reads the line earlier, and keep the x spread at ±0.02.

If the sharpest bends saturate or drop out (signal stops changing as the outer sensors read fully on tape): set sensor_size to 0.016 so each footprint covers more of the 25 mm tape, keeping the current x spread.
If steering_oscillation is high on the slalom while completion is good: reduce body_length to 0.15 and mass to 0.7 to lower yaw inertia, so the robot does not overshoot each direction change.
